int_name: N NEWKIRK ST & W OXFORD ST

result.summary: The residential intersection shown lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Visibility is severely limited by a large utility vehicle parked close to the corner, creating a hazardous environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: No painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to a crossing point.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility truck parked at the corner blocks the view between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Inaccessible curbs
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps prevents safe and easy access for individuals using wheelchairs or strollers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental markings to increase driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Build out the sidewalk at the corner to improve sightlines and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps with tactile warning strips to ensure the intersection is accessible to all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the intersection. Parked vehicles right up to the corner create significant sightline obstructions, and the absence of curb ramps or marked crosswalks limits accessibility and safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian priority or space.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are situated very close to the corner, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking on both sides of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk terminates in a vertical curb without a sloped transition, creating a barrier for mobility-impaired users.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the left foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths across the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety features, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control signage. Parked vehicles near the corners obstruct sightlines, increasing the risk for pedestrians attempting to cross the unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for people with disabilities or strollers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs or yield signs to clarify right-of-way at the intersection.
